personality_one_liner: A calm, premium, and trust-critical vault that treats user data with extreme care, utilizing soft neutrals and deep teal accents to project security and stability.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards and list items should have clear separation without looking detached. Maintain strict 16pt outer horizontal margins.

do's: Use subtle glass effect on the bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it.
Use glass effect for floating action buttons or sticky headers.
Apply glass blur to the PIN entry numpad over the textured background on the App Unlock screen.
dont's: Do not use glass on standard list items, form fields, or primary content cards.

screens.name: App Unlock
screens.purpose: Primary security gateway requiring biometric or PIN entry to access the vault.

states.loading: Subtle blur transition or lock icon resolving.
states.error: Shake animation on numpad + haptic feedback for incorrect PIN.

screens.layout: Full screen layout. Background image with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface). Large centered lock or PersonalPocket logo, followed by a glassmorphic PIN pad and biometric prompt centered in the lower third. Secure, calm, minimal.

screens.name: Credentials Vault (Home)

states.empty: Centered empty state illustration with 'No credentials yet' and a prominent 'Add Credential' CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky large header. Top search bar. Flat list of cards or unified list rows (12pt radius). Each row shows service logo (use image_selector_tool for real PNGs), service name, and user email. Do not show passwords in the list view. FAB for adding new items.

screens.name: Banking Vault
screens.purpose: Organized view of Savings, FDs, RDs, and other deposits.

states.empty: Empty state illustration emphasizing financial security.

screens.layout: Use sectioned lists or segmented controls to divide Savings, FDs, RDs. Cards show bank logo, account reference (masked partially), and balance. A summary header showing total safe value can be included but hidden behind a global 'reveal' eye icon.

screens.name: Investments Vault
screens.purpose: Track Mutual funds, SIPs, SWPs, and market investments.
screens.layout: Segmented by investment type. Clean rows showing provider logo, instrument name, and current value. Touch target to view detail screen.

screens.name: Loans Vault
screens.purpose: Track Home, Vehicle, Personal, and Education loans.
screens.layout: Card layout per loan. Display lender logo, loan type, outstanding amount, and next EMI date. Visually distinguish from positive balances (e.g. muted text or specific warning/neutral tones, avoiding harsh reds unless overdue).

screens.name: Record Detail & Edit Forms
screens.purpose: View full details of a specific record or add/edit one.
screens.layout: Single column form inside KeyboardAvoidingView. Labels above inputs. Sensitive fields (passwords, PINs) MUST be rendered as masked text (`••••••••`) by default, accompanied by a 'Reveal' icon toggle and a 'Copy' icon. Sticky primary CTA (Save/Update) fixed at bottom above home indicator.

screens.name: More (Settings)
screens.purpose: App settings, security controls, and data management.
screens.layout: Grouped list rows for Auto-lock timing, Biometric toggle, Data Export, and 'Delete All Data' (destructive styling). Clean, native iOS settings feel.

auth_background.alt: Soft abstract neutral texture for unlock screen

instructions_to_main_agent: ZERO TOLERANCE: Never display passwords, MPINs, TPINs, or sensitive reference numbers in plain text by default. Always use a masked component with an explicit eye/reveal toggle.
Data Privacy: Ensure 'secureTextEntry' is utilized for secret form inputs. Avoid showing actual secrets in generic 'success' or log outputs.

Branded Entities: When rendering the sample data (banks, services, Netflix, Chase), use the 'image_selector_tool' to fetch real PNG logos. Use initials inside a brandTertiary circle ONLY if a logo is unfound.
Unlock Flow: The App Unlock screen is the root gateway. Make sure it intercepts entry. Use the provided abstract background with a glassmorphic numpad.
Forms: Form inputs should have clear labels. Place sticky Save/Submit buttons inside a fixed container at the bottom, handling KeyboardAvoidingView cleanly.

Colors: Strictly adhere to the provided deep teal (brand) and soft neutral (surface) palette. Avoid default indigos/blues. For Dark Mode, shift surfaces to deep dark teal-tinted charcoal (surface: #0D1112) with adapted brand accents (#42A5B8).
Layouts: Lists should have 16pt uniform padding. Use chips for selecting account types (e.g., Savings, FD, RD) inside the forms.
Apply all listed haptics consistently to tactile actions like PIN entry, masking toggles, and copying secrets.
